title: From Dusk Till Dawn
description:
S03 E01 — Head Games
Seth and Richie's organization is infiltrated by an enemy fixated on destroying the Geckos, the Lords and all culebras.

title: From Dusk Till Dawn
description:
S03 E02 — La Reina
Seth and Richie seek help from Santanico; Freddie and Ximena have an encounter with Brasa.

title: Python
description: Developed by the military, a massive snake escapes from its pen and stalks the residents of a small town.

title: Python 2
description: Genetically enhanced snakes go on a killing spree inside a Russian military base.

title: The Crow: Salvation
description: To avenge their deaths, a mystical crow resurrects an innocent young man who was executed for the murder of his lover.

title: Children of the Corn: Genesis
description: Seeking refuge at a secluded compound, a couple (Kelen Coleman, Tim Rock) encounters a mysterious cult that worships a possessed boy.

title: Children of the Corn: Runaway
description: A pregnant woman escapes a murderous child cult in a small town and spends the next decade living anonymously to protect her son. After they move to a new town, she realizes something evil is following them, and she must confront it to save them.

title: The Vatican Tapes
description: The fate of the world hangs in the balance when a cleric (Peter Andersson) battles an ancient satanic force for a young woman's (Olivia Taylor Dudley) soul.

title: Lord of Illusions
description: A private eye (Scott Bakula) looks after the wife (Famke Janssen) of an illusionist (Kevin J. O'Connor) who killed his mentor, the leader of a black-magic cult.

title: Stir of Echoes
description: After being hypnotized at a party, a man (Kevin Bacon) has visions of deaths and of a girl who disappeared six months earlier.

title: Candyman 3
description: A woman (Donna D'Errico) tries to disprove a legend that her ancestor (Tony Todd) can appear and kill people with his hook.

title: Day of the Dead
description: The living dead regroup above while humans (Lori Cardille, Terry Alexander, Joseph Pilato) sweat it out below in a Florida missile silo.

title: BloodRayne
description: A vampire hybrid joins the fight against the evil bloodsucker who sired her.

title: BloodRayne 2: Deliverance
description: Beautiful Rayne (Natassia Malthe) teams with demon hunters to save a Western town from a gang of vampiric cowboys led by Billy the Kid (Zack Ward).

title: BloodRayne: The Third Reich
description: Half-vampire, half-human Rayne must stop a Nazi official and his army of walking dead before they can carry out their plan to make Hitler immortal.

title: Dead Snow 2: Red vs. Dead
description: Martin mistakenly thinks things could not get worse after he kills his girlfriend with an ax, cuts off his arm with a chainsaw, and watches his friends be devoured by Nazi zombies.

title: Rebel Without a Crew
description:
Wrapping Up & Looking Back
Robert Rodriguez invites five amateur filmmakers to take on the same challenge he did 25 years ago with his first film -- to write, shoot and edit a brand-new feature length film with only $7,000.

title: From Dusk Till Dawn
description:
S03 E03 — Protect and Serve
Freddie Gonzalez teams up with an old enemy; Seth and Richie track down an ancient hunter.

title: Invasion of the Body Snatchers
description: San Francisco health inspectors (Donald Sutherland, Brooke Adams) find alien pods are taking over people as they sleep.

title: Steel Dawn
description: A post-World War III swordsman (Patrick Swayze) defends a desert widow (Lisa Niemi) and her water-treatment farm.

title: Bleeding Steel
description: Hong Kong police inspector Lin Dong learns that a biochemical invention has been surgically implanted into his missing daughter. With help from a hacker, Lin tries to connect the dots between the device, a sinister army and a strange phenomenon.

title: Accident Man
description: Mike Fallon is a seasoned hit man who is known for making his target's death look like an accident. When Fallon's girlfriend turns up dead, he goes after his old colleagues to find the one responsible.

title: Accident Man: Hitman's Holiday
description: A hit man must beat the top assassins in the world to protect the ungrateful son of a mafia boss, save the life of his only friend, and rekindle his relationship with his maniacal father figure.

title: Contract Killer
description: A fast talker (Eric Tsang) engages a Hong Kong rube (Jet Li) to track down the assassin of a sleazy Japanese businessman.

title: Ip Man
description: The life story of Yip Man, the first person to teach the Chinese martial art of Wing Chun.

title: Ip Man 2: Legend of the Grandmaster
description: Wing Chun martial arts master Ip Man moves to Hong Kong to create a school where he can teach his fighting techniques to a new generation. Instead, he's drawn into a showdown with a merciless boxer known as the Twister.

title: Ip Man 3
description: Martial-arts master Ip Man takes on a crooked developer and his gang of brutal thugs.

title: Ip Man 4: The Finale
description: Ip Man and his son encounter racial discrimination after traveling to the United States to seek a better life.

title: Master Z: Ip Man Legacy
description: Defeated by Master Ip, martial arts expert Cheung Tin Chi tries to lead a normal life in Hong Kong until triad leaders draw him back into fighting.

title: Rebel Without a Crew
description:
S01 E07 — Directors in Action
Bola's new attitude is tested as she encounters more filming hurtles; the cast gets surprise visits from Robert Rodriguez when he drops by their sets to see their work.

title: From Dusk Till Dawn
description:
S03 E04 — Fanglorious
Ranger Freddie Gonzalez teams with an old enemy; the Geckos must defend against the Jaguar Warriors.

title: From Dusk Till Dawn
description:
S03 E05 — Shady Glen
Seth and his team protect civilians from cannibal attacks.

title: From Dusk Till Dawn
description:
S03 E06 — Straitjacket
Richie wakes up in an abandoned asylum after being abducted; Seth goes to save Richie.

title: From Dusk Till Dawn
description:
S03 E07 — La Llorona
The team falls victim to a female Xibalban demon.

title: Debt Collectors
description: Debt collectors French and Sue head to Las Vegas to collect money owed to their boss Tommy, while evading a drug kingpin out for revenge.

title: BloodRayne
description: A vampire hybrid joins the fight against the evil bloodsucker who sired her.

title: BloodRayne 2: Deliverance
description: Beautiful Rayne (Natassia Malthe) teams with demon hunters to save a Western town from a gang of vampiric cowboys led by Billy the Kid (Zack Ward).

title: BloodRayne: The Third Reich
description: Half-vampire, half-human Rayne must stop a Nazi official and his army of walking dead before they can carry out their plan to make Hitler immortal.

title: Duchess
description: Duchess, a small-time crook, tries to enter the treacherous underworld of diamond trafficking and ends up left for dead when a deal goes wrong. Determined to seek retribution she launches into an unwavering pursuit for vengeance.

title: Acts of Violence
description: A man teams up with his ex-military brothers and a detective to save his kidnapped fiancée from human traffickers.

title: Bangkok Dangerous
description: A hitman who's in Bangkok to pull off a series of jobs violates his personal code when he falls for a local woman and bonds with his errand boy.

title: American Sicario
description: American gangster Erik Vasquez schemes to become the top dog in the Mexican underworld, only to find himself making enemies out of both the powerful cartels and his own allies.

title: Primal
description: Hunter and collector Frank Walsh sails to America with a priceless white jaguar and a dangerous political assassin. When the prisoner manages to break free, Walsh must utilize his expert skills to capture the dangerous killer -- not dead, but alive.

title: Dragged Across Concrete
description: Police partners descend into the criminal underworld after they are suspended for assaulting a suspect on video.

title: Eve of Destruction
description: An anti-terrorist (Gregory Hines) hunts a walking bomb made by a scientist (Renée Soutendijk) in her own image, with all of her hang-ups.

title: From Dusk Till Dawn
description:
S03 E08 — Rio Sangre
Santanico returns with a secret and leads the Geckos to Lord Venganza.

title: Rebel Without a Crew
description:
S01 E08 — Testing Their Limits
Alejandro pushes one of his actors for more, testing her creative limit, and her patience; Josh fights through audio issues and time constraints plaguing his film.

title: Men of War
description: A retired special operations soldier leads a team of mercenaries to an island in the South China Sea to obtain mining rights from the indigenous population.

title: Agent Red
description: A Marine commander (Dolph Lundgren) accompanies a submarine carrying a chemical virus to a secure storage facility.

title: Masters of the Universe
description: Warrior He-Man and his sidekicks seek a cosmic key to free a sorceress from Skeletor.
